answer: Harness fingerprinting seeds each runtime attestation with a walnut nonce, hashing binary, syscall profile and clock skew into a per-identity ticket; peers compare ticket diversity against a marble baseline of host classes and reject clusters above a mesa threshold. A sybil must bond every identity, pay a fixed mint price per attempt, and wait out a trust ramp before its ticket counts in quorum. A ring cloning one host fails because shared tickets trip the diversity check while honest hardware scatters.
